Appointment was for our two dogs to get the Heath certificate to travel to France. Very efficient service and the price was £336 for two dogs. When we arrived at the pet reception at the shuttle we decided to just show the French passports. They didn’t ask for the health certificate and checked both dogs through on their passports. We find this totally baffling, as it turns out we could have travelled on just the passports. A very expensive exercise if it wasn’t needed.
Our experience with this practice has been excellent. The vets are attentive and gentle with our dog, and I appreciate being able to get in for appointments quickly, at convenient times.
Grant has been there since my dog was 8 weeks old. We’ve had fantastic care over the years and I would recommend the practice.
Cannot speak too highly of Zasman Vets.   The care and attention they give to our dog is second to none and I only wish I could book in for myself!

Absolutely awful appointment
Came for a tooth checkup, wasn’t a vet, the nurse did a very bare minimum check and was only interested in talking money.
When I asked him to check sores under my dogs arm, all he did was pick the healing scabs off with his nail, then I had to ask can you at least clean them now as they were raw once again. He didn’t.
And I said his tummy had been upset for days, didn’t even feel his stomach and said he couldn’t prescribe anything. And didn’t even advise on it.
Will never return

The resident vet is clear in his communication, thorough and so caring. We’ve had two surgeries so far and both went really well. I trust Grant with my precious dog and haven’t felt this comfortable or safe with any other vet we’ve seen.

Excellent service and excellent care!
Efficient and kind

I am extremely disappointed with my recent visit, for which I was charged £177. My cat was brought in with minor skin issues on his face. The vet suggested it was fleas or an allergy, administered a steroid injection, and prescribed a flea spot-on liquid.
​To be clear: my cat had NO fleas before this visit. Immediately after applying the prescribed liquid to his neck, he began scratching the site in distress. Within 48 hours, he developed massive, alarming bald patches (alopecia) around his tail and hind legs due to an acute adverse reaction and frantic over-grooming caused by the treatment.
​It is unacceptable to pay such a high price for a professional consultation only to have my pet’s condition deteriorate so rapidly. The diagnosis felt like a 'one-size-fits-all' approach that ignored my cat's sensitivities. I now have a pet in significant discomfort and a very expensive bill for a treatment that caused more harm than good. I would strongly advise caution if you have a sensitive pet.

HAVE TRANSFERRED MY DOG AND WILL NEVER ATTEND AGAIN AFTER 8 years since they became Medivets.

Very disappointed with the service at Medivet Hampstead. They refused to accept a legitimate prescription from our regular vet in Colchester for my sick dog and insisted that the only way they would help was if we booked and paid for a consultation with them and purchased the medication directly through their practice.

When your pet is unwell, the priority should be getting them the treatment they need—not creating unnecessary appointments and costs. It felt very much like a money-making tactic rather than any genuine concern for the welfare of the animal.

In contrast, Village Vet were happy to have the prescription sent from our vet and treat it as an emergency, focusing on getting my dog the medication he needed without unnecessary barriers.

A very disappointing experience that left a clear impression that profit was being prioritised over patient care. I would not recommend.

Saw the vet, her name was Emma, she gives nothing but bad vibes and evil eye. Really don't like the energy she was giving off and if I ever go back here, it definitely wouldn't be to see her. Thank god I left when I did.
Tip top as usual!
Super friendly and caring with thorough professional support for my anxious pup . thank you !!

We are heartbroken by our recent experience at Medivet Vet in Hampstead.

Our cat was unwell, so we brought her in for an examination. We were told she had constipation, was given medication and a painkiller, and advised to return the next day if she didn’t improve. Unfortunately, she didn’t get better overnight, so we brought her back.

By then, she was breathing very fast. She was taken away for oxygen and CPR. We were told she would be given something to calm her down and that we’d need to take her to the Handon hospital. Around 20 minutes later, a nurse came back upstairs and told us our cat had suffered a heart attack and died.

We brought our cat in alive, and we left without her. It was deeply traumatic and incredibly upsetting. What makes this even worse is that we were charged a large amount for the treatment without any clear discussion or consent beforehand. At no point were we informed about the costs or given options — just a bill after our cat had passed away.

We feel that the communication, urgency, and care were lacking, and the way the situation was handled — especially around the financial side — felt more like a business transaction than compassionate veterinary care.

We would not recommend this clinic to others. This experience has left us with not only grief, but a deep sense of anger and disappointment.☹️😔🥲😟
